title: SEC1: hash_algo_name silent wrong fallback
description:
crypto2dev_hash_algo_name() maps digest length to an algorithm name string for DigestInfo construction in RSA/ECDSA sign and verify. Its default case returns "sha256" with the comment 'safe fallback'.

This fallback is not safe: if a caller passes a SHA-1 (20-byte) or any non-SHA2 digest, the function silently returns "sha256". The resulting DigestInfo OID will be wrong, producing a silently invalid signature or a spurious verification failure. There is no WOLFSSL_MSG or error log at the call site.

Fix: return NULL from the default case. Update callers (crypto2dev_rsa and crypto2dev_ecdsa) to check for NULL and return BAD_FUNC_ARG with a WOLFSSL_MSG.

Affected lines: crypto2dev_port.c:1105, and callers at 1129, 1160, 1207, 1247.
